howto: Tap Play, then read the one-card tutorial on your first run.
Tap or press Space to hop spikes, and hold Down or swipe down to slide under conduits.
Press Shift or swipe right to dash, then tap restart on the results screen for another run.
tips: Save dashes for stacked hazards or a last-second recovery.
High cells are easiest to grab right after a hop.
Watch the sector label: later sectors drain energy faster and throw more hazards.

controls.keyboard: Space hops, Down slides, Shift dashes, Esc or P pauses, M mutes.
controls.touch: Tap to hop, swipe down to slide, swipe right to dash, tap the top-right pause button for the menu.

difficulty: Adaptive ramp: the run starts calm in Sector 1, then energy drain and hazard pressure climb through Sector 5.

cheats.effect: Locks the battery at full charge.
Slows the run for easier reads.
Removes dash cooldown and dash charge cost.

features.one-tap-start: Tap Play, then tap the tutorial card button to begin the run.
features.instant-restart: Run again restarts immediately from the results screen without reloading.
features.best-score-badge: Best score stays on the title and results screens, with a new-best banner for clean runs.
features.tutorial-card: A single first-run tutorial card teaches hop, slide, and dash and can be replayed from the menu or arcade pause menu.
features.results: The results screen shows score, best, and a one-tap Run again button.
